designationHistory.indexText: Colusa National Wildlife Refuge in California's Sacramento Valley was established under the Migratory Bird Conservation Act to give migratory birds sanctuary and to reduce waterfowl damage to crops.
designationHistory.note: FWS only, and the same CCP is inconsistent: several passages say 1945, one table says 1944. No exact date found.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Sacramento, Delevan, Colusa and Sutter NWRs Final CCP and EA, 2009 (ServCat 8237)
